g.text: Five countries assessed (Burkina Faso, Ethiopia, Nigeria, Tanzania, Uganda); two had eligible primary H1 horizons. Ethiopia was excluded from H1 by protocol (no single national lean season); Nigeria and Tanzania had no usable horizon.

text.style: font-size: 7.6px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #52514e

g.text: Protocol locked before access to household- and item-level outcomes, with prior exposure to some published aggregate charts. Under its prespecified rule H1 was contradicted (Uganda individually inconclusive); H3 was supported

text.style: font-size: 7.6px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #52514e

g.text: directionally (Uganda 2022-23 interval includes zero). Whiskers: 95% cluster-bootstrap intervals. Item: 'hungry but did not eat' (FIES item 7).
